title: Weill Cornell Medicine Radiology Research in New York City Reportedly Used Patient Data in AI Tools Without Authorization
summary: Weill Cornell Medicine disclosed that protected health information from NewYork-Presbyterian facilities in New York City was processed by unidentified AI tools during radiology research without authorization. The data included medical record identifiers and clinical details. The institution suspended the research and requested deletion; it reported no evidence of unauthorized viewing or subsequent misuse.
